Conclusion: The test `test_spidermanager_deprecation` checks whether the spider loader is correctly set to an instance of `CustomSpiderLoader` when using a custom SpiderManager class. However, the test failure indicates that this is not the case. Upon examining the `__init__` method of `scrapy.spiderloader.SpiderLoader`, we find that it does not handle the `'SPIDER_MANAGER_CLASS'` setting at all. Instead, it only considers settings related to spider modules (`'SPIDER_MODULES'`). Consequently, when creating a `CrawlerRunner` with `'SPIDER_MANAGER_CLASS': 'tests.test_crawler.CustomSpiderLoader'`, the default `SpiderLoader` is used instead of the custom one, leading to the assertion error demonstrated by the test.

Locations to fix:
```
scrapy.spiderloader.SpiderLoader.__init__(settings)
```
